spec.name: M6.Physical.conv_comm
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b : M6.Physical.Block N), M6.Physical.conv N a b = M6.Physical.conv N b a
spec.guidance: For each i reindex the finite sum by r↦i-r (an involution), then mul_comm. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Physical.conv_add
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a u v : M6.Physical.Block N), M6.Physical.conv N a (u+v) = M6.Physical.conv N a u + M6.Physical.conv N a v
spec.guidance: Extensionality, mul_add and Finset.sum_add_distrib. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Physical.conv_assoc
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b c : M6.Physical.Block N), M6.Physical.conv N a (M6.Physical.conv N b c) = M6.Physical.conv N (M6.Physical.conv N a b) c
spec.guidance: Expand double sums, exchange finite sums and reindex by translations of ZMod N. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Physical.rev_involution
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (a : M6.Physical.Block N), M6.Physical.rev N (M6.Physical.rev N a) = a
spec.guidance: Function extensionality and neg_neg. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Physical.dot_delta
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a : M6.Physical.Block N) (i : ZMod N), M6.Physical.dot N (M6.Physical.delta N i) a = a i
spec.guidance: Expand and use sum_ite_eq. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Physical.rev_weight
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a : M6.Physical.Block N), M6.Physical.weight N (M6.Physical.rev N a) = M6.Physical.weight N a
spec.guidance: Finset.card_bij by i↦-i, self-inverse; do not change definition. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Physical.J_involution
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (z : M6.Physical.Word N), M6.Physical.J N (M6.Physical.J N z) = z
spec.guidance: Unfold J and use rev_involution on both blocks. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Physical.J_weight
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (z : M6.Physical.Word N), M6.Physical.wordWeight N (M6.Physical.J N z) = M6.Physical.wordWeight N z
spec.guidance: Unfold wordWeight,J; rev_weight plus Nat.add_comm. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Physical.boundary_cycle
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b h : M6.Physical.Block N), M6.Physical.syndrome N a b (M6.Physical.boundary N a b h) = 0
spec.guidance: Two convolution terms equal by associativity/commutativity and add_self=0 in ZMod2. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Physical.conv_adjoint
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a h u : M6.Physical.Block N), M6.Physical.dot N (M6.Physical.rev N (M6.Physical.conv N a h)) u = M6.Physical.dot N (M6.Physical.rev N h) (M6.Physical.conv N a u)
spec.guidance: Expand sums; rearrange multiplication, exchange sums then translation reindex i↦i+r. Both are sum_r sum_i a(r)*h(-i-r)*u(i). Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Physical.boundary_pairing
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b h : M6.Physical.Block N) (z : M6.Physical.Word N), M6.Physical.pairing N (M6.Physical.J N (M6.Physical.boundary N a b h)) z = M6.Physical.dot N (M6.Physical.rev N h) (M6.Physical.syndrome N a b z)
spec.guidance: Unfold pairing,J,boundary then conv_adjoint twice, expand dot of a sum. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Physical.cycle_orthogonal
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b : M6.Physical.Block N) (z : M6.Physical.Word N), M6.Physical.syndrome N a b z = 0 ↔ ∀ h : M6.Physical.Block N, M6.Physical.pairing N (M6.Physical.J N (M6.Physical.boundary N a b h)) z = 0
spec.guidance: Use boundary_pairing; forward dot zero. Reverse test h=rev(delta i), rev_involution and dot_delta force each syndrome coordinate0. Return tactic lines only without leading by.
